// No screen to resolve — static ERP values.
if (err) { console.error(screen + ' error:', err); cb([]); return; }
cb(results.map(function(r) { return r.id; }).filter(function(id) { return id != null; }));
// NOTE: unique constraint is (to_date, location_ref_id). If ids[0] already has

// item_ref_id in stepper detail row — pick first item from Item Master

if (err) { console.error(screen + ' error:', err); cb([], []); return; }
var ids   = results.map(function(r) { return r.id; }).filter(function(id) { return id != null; });
// Attribute display names captured for name/code computation (matching batch script logic)
